context_for_next_testing_agent: Unified food search feature fully tested and working. Search endpoint /api/foods/search returns results from USDA FoodData Central and Open Food Facts in parallel. Results are sorted: custom foods first, then USDA with amino acids interleaved with OFF, then branded USDA last. Source badges: cyan for USDA, orange for OFF, purple for custom. OFF food IDs have 'off:' prefix (e.g., off:5449000054227). OFF items show 'Basic Nutrition Data' notice since they don't have amino acid profiles. Search takes 15-25 seconds due to external API latency - tests need appropriate wait times.
